### What I tried (all denied, no interactive prompt available)
| Attempt | Tool | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| `curl https://en.wikipedia.org/w/api.php?action=query&prop=info&titles=Antidisestablishmentarianism&format=json&redirects=1` | bash | `permission required but no prompt available for bash` |
| XTools `pageinfo/en.wikipedia.org/Antidisestablishmentarianism` | webfetch | `permission required but no prompt available for webfetch` |
| XTools API `api/page/info/...` | webfetch | denied |
| History API (`prop=revisions`, `rvdir=newer`, `rvstart=2023-06-30T23:59:59Z`) | webfetch | denied |
| `websearch` for cached revision counts | websearch | `permission required but no prompt available for websearch` |

Local file tools (`read`/`grep`/`glob`) work, so I checked for any cached copy of the data instead:
- `.goathome/sessions/` contains **five** prior sessions on this exact question. Four (`20260915-184232l8te`, `-201954tep9`, `-2040355ejq`, `-205524naqx`) are 2-line stubs with no work done; `20260916-012414wk5i` made the same three calls (bash curl, webfetch to the API, webfetch to XTools) and got the same permission errors.
- `grep` across all sessions for `num_edits|revs|revision count|edit counter` found **only tool-call attempts and error strings — never a response payload.** No revision data exists on disk.

So there is zero primary evidence available in this environment, and **I am not reporting a number**: any figure I gave would be invented, not measured.

### The exact procedure that will answer it (run once bash/webfetch are allowed)
1. Identity + creation date: `action=query&prop=info&titles=Antidisestablishmentarianism&inprop=protection&format=json&redirects=1` → confirm canonical `pageid` (note it currently redirects to the "Opposition to the disestablishment of the Church of England" era title only if renamed; use the returned `pageid`, not the title, for revision queries).
2. Count revisions up to 2023-06-30 inclusive, paginating oldest-first so `rvcontinue` walks from inception:
   `action=query&prop=revisions&pageids=<id>&rvdir=newer&rvlimit=500&rvprop=ids|timestamp|flags|comment|user&rvstart=2023-06-30T23:59:59Z&format=json`
   Repeat with `rvcontinue` until exhausted; the sum of `rev` elements is the count. `rvdir=newer` + `rvstart` behaves as "revisions ≤ 2023-06-30T23:59:59Z, oldest first."
3. Cross-check with XTools `pageinfo` → its "Revisions" figure as of the query date, and `action=query&list=users&usprop=editcount`-style sanity checks for top contributors.
4. Decide the two ambiguities that make this question answer-variable: (a) whether "edits" means **all revisions including deleted ones** (add `rvdeleted=1`) or only visible revisions; (b) whether it counts only the main namespace or also the Talk page; (c) timezone cutoff (MediaWiki timestamps are UTC — "until June 2023" = before `2023-07-01T00:00:00Z`).

### To verify on your side
Grant `bash` or `webfetch` permission (the denial messages indicate the permission system had no prompt to offer, i.e. non-interactive mode), then re-run me — I'll return the verified count plus the page creation date and the XTools cross-check.
